title: The Mental Model
use_cases: Use when designing data structures for Large Language Model prompts
Implement when architecture requires separating different types of input data
Configure when troubleshooting model confusion or performance degradation
Use when scaling a complex application feature like screenplay conversion
content:
Before we write a single line of code, we need to redefine what “Context” actually means. In the world of LLMs, we often treat context like a bucket: you just pour everything in until it overflows.

But for complex apps, context isn’t a liquid, it’s a layer cake. Through building the Convert Screenplay feature, we realized that “context” actually breaks down into three distinct categories. If you mix them up, your model gets confused. If you manage them separately, you get consistency.
